entries.title: Spawn Meadow
entries.summary: The safe-ish landing: tall grass, expedition tents, and training dummies. Zone effects here are practice hazards, not real threats.

entries.title: Northern Icefield
entries.summary: A frozen shelf roughly 175u north of camp where freeze and stun zones occur naturally. Home turf of the Stoneguard and the first real difficulty step.

entries.title: Thornveil
entries.summary: A bramble forest east of the meadow with dense sightlines and ranged ambushes. Spear-thrower territory.

entries.title: Ashfang Packs
entries.summary: Aggressive pack hunters with scarred hide and ember-red markings. They charge on sight and overwhelm through pressure, not tactics.

entries.title: Stoneguard Remnant
entries.summary: A defensive order that outlived whatever it guarded — slate-grey, broad, and slow. It holds ground and punishes overreach.

entries.title: Thornveil Skirmishers
entries.summary: Lean, fast, territorial spear-throwers of the eastern brambles. They strike from range, relocate, and repeat.

entries.title: Unaligned Wilds
entries.summary: Creatures no faction ever claimed — straylings that drift the meadow's edge and the ground between regions, belonging to nothing. The balanced walks the middle line of everything, the hybrid mixes a thrown strike with a closing one, and their apex, the twin-striking double-attacker, is the meadow's first true wall.

entries.title: The Expedition
entries.summary: The player's own side: the party that reopened the meadow and the camp that supports it. The player is an expedition member; the camp quartermaster holds the line between the tents and everything past them. Anchored in the Spawn Meadow.
